caption: The drawing depicts a dark brown, ornate, ironwork bracket set against a light beige or off-white background. The bracket is triangular in composition, with its base aligned horizontally at the bottom and its height on the right side of the image. The design features a large central spiral or volute, with a smaller, secondary spiral at the bottom left. Leaf-like and berry cluster motifs are integrated along the curves and inner spaces, adding decorative detail. The right edge has a straight vertical support, while the leftmost end of the bracket terminates with a circular form enclosing a stylized flower. The entire structure is outlined and shaded to give a sense of three-dimensionality, and there is a handwritten signature with a date in the center below the drawing.
title: Scroll
